mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 signals an economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's tightening of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profit margins and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, increasing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 persons (150 in thousands) signals strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 150.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and RSAFS < 500000.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), wage pressures accelerate, leading to inflationary expectations and Federal Reserve tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflationary wage pressures
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5.
